scripts.k6:cursor: docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "${PWD}/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000 -e LIMIT=50 grafana/k6 run --out influxdb=http://host.docker.internal:8086/k6 /scripts/cursor-pagination.js
scripts.k6:cursor:local: docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "${PWD}/k6:/scripts" -e BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000 -e LIMIT=50 grafana/k6 run /scripts/cursor-pagination.js

scripts.k6:round2:local: mkdir -p reports && docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "${PWD}/k6:/scripts" -v "${PWD}/reports:/reports" -e BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000 grafana/k6 run --summary-export=/reports/round2-summary.json /scripts/round2.js
